topNews.text: Knee Pain Suffered by Millions Can Be Eased Using New Non-Surgical Procedure
topNews.excerpt: For millions of people suffering with knee pain, a new, non-surgical procedure offers the promise of easing it away for at least 12 months with a single injection. Genicular artery embolization, or GAE, is an emerging, minimally invasive treatment that targets abnormal blood vessels in osteoarthritis patients.
